Kar'niss is a drider in service of the Absolute, whom he now serves after being cast out by Lolth, the Queen of Spiders.
“
They must keep up. The shadows are hungry.
„
— Kar'niss

Overview

Kar'niss is a key character involved in the questline ⁠Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse, since he carries a  Moonlantern that holds the trapped pixie  Dolly Dolly Dolly. He believes anyone who perishes to the  Shadow Curse makes it stronger, and is starkly opposed to 'feeding' it.

Involvement

Act Two

Arriving from the Rosymorn Monastery Trail

If the party arrive from the Rosymorn Monastery Trail a group of Absolute followers lead by  Kansif are waiting for True Souls to arrive and summon the guide. The party can use a  Spider's Lyre to summon Kar'niss, then ⁠follow the convoy to Moonrise Towers. The party is then ambushed by the Harpers midway and has the choice to side with the convoy or the Harpers. Either choice leads to a combat encounter with the other group.

Arriving from the Underdark

If the party arrive from Grymforge and reach a large ruined building at X: 10 Y: -15 the convoy arrives without them and the Harpers are absent; the party can then reveal themselves or hide. If they stay hidden initially, Kar'niss murders  Vez in anger as she is about to leave the light and feed the Shadow Curse further. If the party reveal themselves they can follow the convoy to Moonrise Towers without issue, attack the convoy or demand the  Moonlantern for themselves.

It is possible to avoid this scene by jumping up to a smaller ruined building along the eastern side and then reach Kansif, then summon the convoy as if they were arriving from the Monastery Trail. Once the party speak with  Gronag, the caravan no longer triggers mid-transit without the Harpers.

Harper ambush

Finally the party may encounter Kar'niss' caravan mid-transit alongside the Harpers to ambush them and claim the lantern as part of a quest ⁠Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse given by  Jaheira at Last Light Inn. The party can choose to follow the convoy to Moonrise, kill Kar'niss and his followers to take his lantern, or convince him through dialogue to relinquish it and walk away to their deaths. Disarming Kar'niss causes him to drop the Moonlantern and grants the inspiration ⁠Shiny Trinkets and Baubles to party members with the  Criminal background.

If Kar'niss and his convoy are convinced to leave without the Moonlantern, they can later be encountered as  Shadow-Cursed Undead in Reithwin Town, south of the statue of  Ketheric Thorm outside the Sharran Sanctuary and north of the bridge to Moonrise Towers. They are automatically hostile to the party in this form and can only be fought, although Kar'niss still appears as  Temporarily Hostile if attacked. He is joined by several  Shadows, undead Harpers, and undead prisoners.

If Kar'niss survives the journey to Moonrise Towers, he runs up the tower to seek the Absolute's blessing on the rooftop, where he can be encountered one final time as he fights alongside Ketheric when they storm the tower at the end of Act Two. The Dark Urge will also receive ⁠Fly-Swatter upon arriving with him to Moonrise Towers.

Speak with Dead

Kar'niss' corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Kar'niss
      Erased... forgotten... we are... drider...
  • What happened to you?
    • Kar'niss
      Lolth... cast out... Absolute... saved...
  • Who killed you?
    • Kar'niss
      Traitor... heretic...
  • Where are you from?
    • Kar'niss
      Moonrise...
  • What were you doing?
    • Kar'niss
      Shepherding... the faithful... carrying... our Lady's light...
  • You walk the shadows safely. How?
    • Kar'niss
      Lantern... our Lady's light...
  • How did you trap that pixie in the lantern?
    • Kar'niss
      Always... many voices... hers... the LOUDEST...
  • How did the shadow curse come to be?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*

Bugs

  • If summoned with the lyre after killing the Absolute followers at the meeting point, a dialogue bug may occur: none of the skill check dialogue options works and the player character is booted out from the Kar'niss dialogue whenever one of these is selected. Currently, no solution to this bug is known.

Notes

  • As a drider, Kar'niss is half drow - which means his weapon,  Cruel Sting, grants extra Poison damage (as it does when wielded by a drow.)[verify]
